classification: structural nonlinear divergence triggered by an unbounded first coupling update

coupling.condition: RMS(residual) < 1e-6 or ||residual||_2 / d < 1e-6, with d=||current_data||_2 unless that norm is below 1e-15, in which case d=1

last_complete_step_load_diagnostics.interpretation: No temporal load or moment spike exists in the last accepted VTK state; the failed-step predictor/load is not flushed to VTK.

nan_mechanism.effect: A sufficiently large Newton rotation increment makes the square-root argument negative and contaminates quaternion, internal force, tangent and residual with NaN.
nan_mechanism.evidence_boundary: No element instrumentation was added under the four-mapper-file scope, so delta_phi itself was not logged. The link from the diverging correction sequence to this explicit square-root failure path is a code-level inference.

ordering: map scaled fluid reaction to beam
apply alpha=0.03 relaxation only if not converged
coupling_ordering.consequence: The configured coupling relaxation cannot protect the first structural solve of a new time step.

recommended_convergence_design: Replace the full derivative predictor by a bounded predictor or trust-region update on interface displacement.
Reject and roll back a coupling iterate immediately when the structural solver returns false or any state becomes non-finite.
Globalize the structural Newton correction so every incremental rotation remains inside the CrBeam quaternion chart; this requires solver/element work outside the four mapper files.
After stability is enforced, use a bounded adaptive accelerator to recover coupling efficiency.
Do not relax the 1e-6 convergence tolerances and do not increase 150 Newton iterations; neither can recover a NaN state.
